summary: WeRide Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed (Stock Code 0800) foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its November 6, 2026 HKEX announcement of the date of a board meeting. The board will meet November 20, 2026 (Beijing/Hong Kong time) to consider and approve unaudited third-quarter 2026 results for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and their publication, with an earnings call at 9:00 P.M. HK or 8:00 A.M. ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or recommendation is stated; this is a routine results-calendar notice with no special-situation mechanics, so no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
